challenge.method: Tested whether the evidence identified only a title, whether the copying terms covered a different repository asset or a user's Work, and whether the trademark paragraph narrowed copyright redistribution of this file.
challenge.results: The title identifies the file. The README's Copying and licenses paragraph supplies the operative dedication and expressly names legal-tool text as its object. The file path, edition example and operative contents place this plaintext in that class. The separate trademark paragraph regulates use of marks and logos. The later Vocabulary, CSS and font provisions address other assets.

limitations: The conclusion covers copyright reuse of the identified 7,048-byte file. The exact-copy condition defines this claim's scope.
Creative Commons separately limits use of its trademarks and logos, subject to its stated exceptions. Other repository assets have their own terms.
Rights in a Work to which someone applies CC0 depend on that Affirmer and that Work. The README's dedication concerns the legal-tool text itself.
reasoning: The pinned README dedicates “the text of the Creative Commons legal tools” under CC0 1.0 Universal. At the same commit, the identified file is the English legal code for one of those tools. The publisher's dedication therefore reaches its copyright in this plaintext. Section 1(i) includes reproduction and distribution among the rights addressed by the waiver and conditional fallback, which supports redistribution of an exact copy.
